findings.containment: The channel adds an object-and-cargo relation; it does not replace the ordinary reading that the vessel was placed in the brother’s load.

findings.title: The established sign-machine reverses
findings.claim: The focus is the dark second pass through an established sign-machine: the first baggage insertion invites recognition and return, while the second redirects recognition into accusation and retention.
findings.mechanism: The focus repeats an earlier hidden-placement grammar but reverses its semiotic output. Merchandise placed in baggage becomes a benevolent sign that is found, recognized, and returned; the vessel placed in one brother's baggage becomes an incriminating sign that converts discovery into accusation and retention.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the placement as a second pass through recognition and return, with the sign’s social effect reversed.
findings.containment: Attributed pericope-level activation; The packet supplies two concealed placements and the first one's recognition-return cycle; I infer that the second deliberately reverses the sign's function from gift to evidence. A live alternative is that the two placements are parallel tactics without a designed semiotic contrast.

epistemic.reason: Exact HFT coordinates and roles return to the focus, while legacy_unbound provenance qualifies rather than verifies the branch.

findings.title: Measure converts into person
findings.claim: The cup is a conversion device: a standard from the provisioning system is moved into the brother's bag so that measured food, royal property, a camel load, and finally the brother's person can be exchanged across one procedure.
findings.mechanism: Repeated food measurement is conditioned on bringing the brother; after the focus, the planted vessel is identified as a sovereign measuring cup, paired with a camel-load reward, and used in a penalty that lets the found person stand as recompense. The object becomes a conversion token between provisions, authority, and a body.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can track the cup across rationing, royal property, a camel load, and the person treated as recompense.
findings.containment: Attributed pericope-level activation; The packet supplies repeated measure, a sovereign measuring vessel, a load reward, and a substitutionary penalty; I infer a conversion chain from food quantity through proof-object to person. The live alternative is that the cup is only a convenient identifiable object and the quantitative echoes are incidental.
